# Vendored hafley-rs crates

Source: https://github.com/hafley66/hafley-rs/tree/1fbf655a0ed229c43a0eb59caa87206025059dc9/crates

`hafley-observe` and `sqlite-bulk-trigger` contain the tracked crate files and both upstream licenses. Cargo workspace metadata and dependencies are expanded in each manifest so checkout and CI do not require an external worktree. Shared library changes belong upstream, then are copied here.
